title: British Almond Fritters
description: A delicious and traditional British dessert, these fritters are filled with ground almonds and perfect for snacking.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together the ground almonds, sugar, and eggs.
Add the flour mixture to the almond mixture and whisk until just combined.
Add the buttermilk and melted butter, and whisk until the batter is smooth.
Using a tablespoon, drop the batter into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
Dust the fritters with confectioners' sugar and serve warm.
Repeat with the remaining batter, adjusting the heat as needed to prevent the oil from getting too hot.
